map.Cramér's V 由卡方统计量 χ² 除以样本量与最小维度约束后开方得到，把: Cramér's V divides the chi-square statistic χ² by the sample size and the smallest dimension constraint, then takes the square root, standardizing chi-square to the 0-1 range to measure the association between two categorical variables: 0 means no association and 1 complete association, applicable to contingency tables of any size. This page computes it from the four frequencies of a 2×2 table.
map.V∈[0,1]，越大关联越强。: V lies in [0,1]: the larger it is, the stronger the association.
map.列联表关联强度：V=√(χ²/(n·min(r−1,c−1)))。: Association strength in a contingency table: V=√(χ²/(n·min(r−1,c−1))).
map.0 至 1，标准化使不同表可比。: Ranges from 0 to 1, standardized so different tables are comparable.
map.χ²=20、n=200、min(1,1)=1：V=√(20/200)=√0.1≈: χ²=20, n=200, min(1,1)=1: V=√(20/200)=√0.1≈0.316, a moderate association.
map.χ²=4、n=100：V=√(4/100)=0.2，较弱。: χ²=4, n=100: V=√(4/100)=0.2, a weak association.
